Toughened smoke glass

Ink under
glass.

The mark is printed beneath the face, a film twenty micrometres thin, so nothing on the surface can wear it away. A diamond-cut rim catches the light at the edge.

0µm ink film
0glass index

Nappa leather

Soft where it
touches you.

Compressed nappa cushions with a bound seam and saddle stitches set by the row. The crown wraps the same leather over a knit inner pad.

Articulation

Built to
move.

Four motions, each on its own joint. Scroll through them.

  1. Fit0.0 mmTelescoping rail, four engraved stops
  2. Swivel0°Cups turn flat on a radial bearing

  4. Dial0°96 machined flutes under the thumb

Construction

Eight layers,
one cup.

From the glass you see to the cushion you feel, every part is its own piece, seated rather than glued over.

  1. Toughened smoke glass
  2. Under-glass ink
  3. Graphite glass backing
  4. Diamond-cut rim
  5. Sculpted solid shell
  6. Replaceable baffle seat
  7. Woven acoustic cloth
  8. Nappa cushion

Replaceable cushions

Lifts away.
Seats back.

Each cushion rides on its own carrier. Lift it straight off the baffle to clean or replace it; it seats back in the same place.
